A dice toy for your Nothing Phone (4a) Pro Glyph Matrix.

1. Tap the button below (or open Settings > Glyph Interface > Glyph Toys).
2. Drag "Dice" from Disabled into the active toys.
3. Long-press the Glyph button to roll.
Open Settings > Glyph Interface > Glyph Toys, then enable \"Dice\".
